messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool "juno-vpc-pool" — tenant=juno-health GPU util=99% · queue=237 · evictions=3 · latency p99=12s. Severity: P2. Paging #incidents SRE oncall @olivia
olivia: I'm oncall — looking now. @ranjit can you pull recent queue/eviction logs?
ranjit: grabbing metrics, posting short snippet:
```
pool:juno-vpc-pool gpu_util=99%
tenant:juno-health queued=237 in_flight=48 evictions=3
avg_token_latency=1.2s p99=12.1s
backpressure=true
```
maria: runtime note — KV cache for long-chat sessions is filling GPU memory. Two quick levers: (1) short burst to add 6–8 GPUs, (2) apply tenant-level rate limit to protect other tenants. Both doable.
samir: cc @june-juno (Juno ops) — we need customer sign-off to initiate burst (it will incur extra cost).
june-juno: Juno ops here — we authorize a temporary burst. Approve up to 45 minutes to clear backlog. Notify with cost estimate. :white_check_mark:
olivia: OK initiating burst request: `/rb burst create --pool juno-vpc-pool --add-gpus 8 --duration 45m --reason "tenant queue spike"` — kicking it now. Also applying soft rate-limit to tenant: 60% of steady-state.
ranjit: burst accepted by autoscaler; new nodes registering. Early telemetry: queued -> 180 after 90s. Eviction events decreased.
maria: applying runtime config to evict stale KV entries older than 24h for tenant juno-health (cfg id cfg-2026-09-juno). This should free ~15% memory headroom.
samir: sent customer cost note: estimated delta +$5.2k for 45m burst. Juno confirmed receipt and acked cost.
june-juno: Confirmed, budget ok. Please keep us posted if burst extends.
olivia: Observed queue 78 at +6m, p95 latency down to 980ms. Marking escalation mitigated but keeping channel open. Handoff: I'm stepping out in 30m — handing to night oncall @dave. Key notes in runbook: short burst approved, tenant-rate-limit enabled, cfg-2026-09-juno applied.
dave: taking the handoff. I'll watch autoscaler events, GPU OOMs, and any rollback needs. Please add any last test points.
ranjit: watchlist: autoscale API errors, pod-preempt log spikes, and eviction count. If queue stalls >120 for 10m, escalate to eng-runtime.
maria: quick sanity: disable long_prefix_preload for tenant if p99 stays >8s. Command: `POST /runtime/configs/juno-health?patch=disable_long_preload`
samir: customer-eng note: customer success loop is on standby for any visible regression to app UX.
incident-bot: Incident updated · status=mitigated · impact=tenant-only · duration=~10m of highest pressure. Keep channel for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
olivia: thanks team. dave — I left links to logs and the burst transaction in the thread. Please close when stable.
dave: will do. Monitoring  — will update in 30m or earlier if anything changes.
